This meets the definition of 'Fighting — MUTUAL combat — TWO OR MORE people BOTH actively throwing punches/kicks at EACH OTHER'.

The victim remains motionless on the floor throughout, suggesting incapacitation or unconsciousness. This constitutes an assault, not mutual combat, but still a clear violent anomaly.

This is not mutual combat (only one person is actively engaging while the other is supine and passive), but it qualifies as violent abnormal activity (assault).
